$comment: Project identity, used to build absolute URLs in generated files. This lives in config rather than being read from the git remote on purpose: rendering must be a pure function of version-controlled inputs. Reading the remote made output depend on local git state, so a fresh clone, a fork and CI would each render different badge URLs — and CI's `render --check` would fail depending on which machine ran it.
name: Awesome Agent Tools

tagline.en: Building an "AGI" out of the tools we already have.
